title: Real-Time London Underground Monitoring Platform
summary: Full-stack monitoring platform leveraging background asynchronous polling, differential WebSockets, and spatial-temporal database optimizations for real-time TfL transit tracking.
highlights: Built a FastAPI background worker (httpx + asyncio) to continuously ingest live Transport for London (TfL) REST API feeds.
Engineered a dynamic WebSocket system that performs differential state updates to minimize network bandwidth usage.
Optimized historical delay querying in PostgreSQL 15 & SQLAlchemy 2.0 (asyncpg) utilizing DISTINCT ON indexing strategies.
Developed an interactive Streamlit & Pandas analytics dashboard displaying operational statuses and live disruption metrics.

title: Breakthrough Game AI Engine
summary: Symbolic Artificial Intelligence engine for Breakthrough incorporating Minimax with Alpha-Beta Pruning, Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), and metaheuristic optimization.
highlights: Engineered a Java-based chess-variant core engine for rules validation, board state management, and move evaluation.
Optimized decision tree traversal with Alpha-Beta Pruning, dynamic search depth tuning, and flexible heuristic interfaces.
Built Genetic Algorithm (tournament selection) and Simulated Annealing stochastic algorithms to auto-calibrate heuristic weights.
Implemented Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to evaluate optimal move trajectories via statistical playouts.

title: Multiplayer Clue (Cluedo) Game
summary: Distributed multiplayer adaptation of Cluedo featuring real-time socket communications, encrypted state transmission, and a JavaFX dynamic UI.
highlights: Designed a distributed Java backend utilizing client-server sockets for real-time multiplayer session state sync.
Built a custom client-server encryption protocol to secure secret card data transfers across the network.
Created a JavaFX, FXML, and CSS graphical user interface integrated with a persistent SQL database.
Implemented an XML-driven feature-flipping system to dynamically toggling runtime features without application redeployment.

title: Convex Hull Geometric Engine
summary: Low-level C 2D geometric engine implementing baseline computational geometry algorithms, benchmarking tools, and custom self-balancing data structures.
highlights: Implemented 2D Convex Hull algorithms completely from scratch in C: Jarvis March O(nh), Graham Scan O(n log n), and QuickHull O(n log n).
Designed dynamic runtime algorithm selectors alongside performance benchmarking suites.
Built custom self-balancing search trees (AVL/Red-Black balance patterns) and dual Heap implementations (tree-based and array-based).
Optimized pre-sorting phases by engineering custom Heapsort and exchange sort routines directly over complex pointer structures.

title: Systems Programming & Engineering Suite
summary: A collection of software engineering projects targeting low-level memory allocation, 3D ray tracing math, simulation heuristics, and CLI applications.
highlights: Ray Tracing Engine (Saturn): Implemented 3D vector computations and mathematical ray-object intersection modeling to render scenes.
Population Dynamics Simulator: Built a population genetics simulation engine utilizing custom heuristic algorithms.
Graph Theory & Memory Management: Executed graph traversal algorithms under strict dynamic memory constraints (malloc/calloc/free) ensuring zero leaks.
Terminal Game Engine: Structured state machines and business logic for a CLI-based Yahtzee (Yams) game.
